title: Reporter's Notebook: Finding World Cup joy in speaking to women who love soccer
summary: Tune into World Cup coverage, and you are likely to see waves of male, screaming, sweaty fans. But one of the joys of covering this World Cup has been speaking to women who love soccer.
contentText:
